Subject: Vendor onboarding: invoice channel preference & sample CSV headers

Hi Marissa,

Thanks for taking onboarding with BeamTech. We are ready to submit our first batch of invoices and want to confirm the preferred intake method and header layout. Two quick questions: 1) Do you prefer suppliers use the portal exclusively or may we send invoices via email as a backstop? 2) If email is acceptable for the pilot, can you confirm a compact CSV header set that will map cleanly into your AP system?

Attached is a single-row sample we generated (sample_invoice.csv) — it shows our current fields. We can adapt. Specifics that matter for us: multi-PO support in a single file, VAT/GST handling, and acknowledgement behavior (do you send an automated ACK with an ID?).

We'd like to pilot with 25 invoices in week of Apr 19 if that works for you.

Thanks,
Elena Soto

BeamTech, Inc.

Subject: Re: Vendor onboarding: invoice channel preference & sample CSV headers

Elena — thanks for the sample and clear questions. TL;DR: portal-first, email backstop allowed for pilot with a subject token; minimal CSV headers below.

Portal vs email
- Portal: preferred (better idempotency, structured attachments, faster ACKs).
- Email: acceptable as fallback during pilot. If you send via email, please use the subject token we provide (we'll issue one for BeamTech) and attach CSV or PDF. Emails without the token will be quarantined for manual triage.

Minimal CSV header recommendations (compact, required):
- invoice_id
- invoice_date (YYYY-MM-DD)
- vendor_name
- vendor_tax_id (optional but recommended for EU vendors)
- po_number (can be blank for non-PO invoices)
- line_number
- line_description
- quantity
- unit_price
- tax_amount
- line_total
- currency (ISO 4217)
- remit_address

Optional helpful fields: source_system_reference, supplier_contact_email, invoice_pdf_filename

ACK behavior
- For portal submissions: automatic ACK in < 30s with token: "ACK: RECEIVED invoice_id=<id> status=QUEUED" and a processing_id for support lookups.
- For emailed CSV/PDF with subject token: ACK within 10m during business hours, otherwise next business day.

Multi-PO and multi-PO-per-PDF
- CSV: each row should include po_number. Multiple PO numbers across rows in same file are fine.
- PDFs: we prefer per-invoice PDFs uploaded to portal. If sending a multi-invoice PDF by email, please ensure each invoice header includes the PO and invoice_id so we can split programmatically. There is a higher manual review rate for multi-PO PDFs sent by email.

Pilot suggestion
- Start portal for 10 canonical invoices and use email backstop for 15 more while we validate ACKs and mapping. Please complete the attached onboarding form (onboarding_form.pdf) and we will issue a subject token and a sandbox portal access link.

Elena — quick follow from infra/setup side:

VAT/tax handling
- Preferred: tax_amount per line (tax_amount column) — it maps reliably to our ledger.
- Acceptable alternative: invoice_tax_total field can be supplied, but we will need a tax_breakdown JSON blob for reconciliation (for email CSVs you can include a tax_breakdown column with a compact encoded string, e.g. "VAT:20%:12.34;GST:5%:3.21"). If that's difficult, include invoice_tax_total and we will flag for a manual reconcile step.

Multi-PO PDFs
- Combined PDFs with discrete pages per invoice are generally parseable if each page has a recognizable header with invoice_id and po_number. Please place a small page footer with the invoice_id to avoid split errors.

Practical notes
- We will provision a subject token for BeamTech within 24h of receiving the completed vendor_onboarding_form.pdf. Please send the completed PDF back to marissa_cole@redwood.example with Cc: karthik_iyer so we can expedite portal sandbox creation.
- Link to onboarding docs: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aB_example_onboarding_docs

Thanks — looking forward to the pilot.

-Karthik
